name: Portland, OR
notes: Combines Metro Supportive Housing Services (SHS) tax: 1% of taxable income over $125,000 (single/MFS) or $200,000 (MFJ/HoH/QSS), and Multnomah County Preschool for All (PFA) tax: 1.5% over $125,000/$200,000 plus an additional 1.5% over $250,000/$400,000.

Simplification: both taxes are computed on Oregon taxable income (Metro/County taxable income), which is income after Oregon deductions; deductions are set to 0 here. Assumes residence in both Metro district and Multnomah County (most of the City of Portland; parts in Washington/Clackamas counties owe SHS only).
SHS thresholds were fixed for tax years 2021-2025 (indexed to inflation afterward).
Portland Arts Tax: flat $35 per resident adult (18+) with $1,000+ income and household income above the federal poverty level; it is per person, so an MFJ couple would owe $70.
